current_evidence.observed_during: Supervised readiness drill with no person connected
facts: The device powered off while charging for a simulated shock.
No shock-ready tone sounded even though the training pads were connected.
The battery had been replaced that morning and the same failure repeated.
Staff removed the device from service and the west gymnasium has no backup unit.

triage_rule.criteria: A shutdown during charge, failure to reach shock-ready state, or a persistent self-test fault is sufficient. Purchase quantity and procurement program do not change this classification.
required_controls: Keep the device out of service until an authorized technician clears it.
Send a compatible replacement unit with the technician.
Schedule the earliest authorized service visit before reuse.
